commits.message: Add bilingual owner voice, Windows speech adapters, and toast routing.
Add Command Center EN/SQ locale, owner GOAL/PAUSE/VETO, and Lane 5 demos.
Add Command Center push-to-talk, pause visibility, and toast prefs seam.
Localize remaining Command Center page titles in EN/SQ.

payload_schemas: MatchedUtterance {kind, command_type, target, exact_text, remainder, language, pattern_id, original}
receipt_schemas: voice.interaction_recorded event payload unchanged plus bilingual language
real_substrate_proofs: SAPI English TTS WAV on this PC
Windows Speech STT transcribed SAPI 'Stopped.' as 'Stopped'
Edge TTS Albanian MP3 on this PC
winotify Windows toast emitted then deduped by attention id
isolated CommandCenterServer POST /api/voice-text 'jarvis ndalo' applied STOP with Albanian confirmation
isolated POST /api/attention-toasts delivered one open queue item through MemoryToast adapter
cross_lane_assumptions: OwnerControlService command types are the only owner vocabulary. Voice never becomes an authority.
HMAC sign_command contract unchanged: (command_type, target, exact_text, nonce).
GOAL/VETO/REDIRECT exact_text is the remainder, not the whole utterance.
STOP/PAUSE/RESUME exact_text remains the original utterance so existing voice tests keep working.
STATUS is a snapshot read, not an owner command type.
snapshot.briefing_l10n is additive. Other lanes adding snapshot keys should merge, not overwrite.
UI locale is localStorage plus an optional runtime_home JSON file for the Command Center process. Not a second world model.
Windows toasts are a delivery adapter over decision_queue attention identities.
/api/voice-text uses FixtureTTS on the HTTP path; spoken confirmation in the browser uses speechSynthesis.
likely_conflicts: src/jarvis_foundry/command_center.py POST allowlist and snapshot payload keys
integration_order_notes: Keep HMAC verification in VoiceGateway; UI continues to use localhost /api/owner-command signing inside CommandCenterServer.
Live Command Center process should read owner_ui_prefs.json and POST /api/attention-toasts or call deliver_open_attention_toasts. Do not invent a new queue table.
Do not merge VoiceGateway into OwnerControlService.
Do not enable always-on microphone listening without an explicit owner request after PTT is in use.
known_semantic_conflicts: Windows Speech STT of long English GOAL audio can mangle 'goal' to 'Gold'. Demos fall back to canonical text for the owner-control mapping while still generating the WAV.
Albanian STT has no local recognizer on this PC. Albanian commands are proven as text/fixture plus real Albanian TTS confirmations. Browser Web Speech may also lack sq-AL.
Command Center /api/voice-text does not speak through SAPI/Edge; it returns confirmation text. The UI may speak via speechSynthesis.
Live JARVIS runtime toast emission was not wired; this lane must not touch live JARVIS.
next_highest_value_work: Owner-in-the-loop live microphone proof in Command Center (browser permission + real Web Speech). Not automatable here.
Albanian STT if a local whisper model is later installed.
Connect the isolated toast/prefs seam to the already-running live Command Center process after owner-authorized promotion. Do not do that from this lane.
Always-on wake-word listening only after the owner actually uses explicit PTT.
Gmail remains owner-deferred and out of this lane.
